# 1969–1975: Michigan State, Fermilab, and the Architecture of a Life

The year 1969 arrived with the weight of Apollo 11 and Woodstock and Altamont, a year that seemed to contain the entire spectrum of human possibility—the best and worst of what the species could achieve in a single twelve-month period. Bob was seventeen, about to enter Michigan State University, about to begin the formal engineering education that would shape his professional identity for the next four decades.
